context.person: A person using a learning video library
context.user_goal: Use a related tutorial and retain any personal notes.

product_state.preceding_state: A saved tutorial was removed by its publisher.
product_state.current_state: The saved tutorial is no longer available. The removal does not affect other saved videos.
known_facts: The saved tutorial is no longer available.
The removal does not affect other saved videos.
Two tutorials cover the same skill level.
Notes attached to the removed video remain downloadable.
forbidden_claims: The publisher will restore the tutorial.

challenge: Rewrite the unavailable or empty state so the person can understand saved video no longer available, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Download notes from the unavailable video.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The original video cannot be watched.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Use a related tutorial and retain any personal notes.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
